name: sacdfs
description: Serves SACD disc images (ISO files) as DSF and WAV files over SMB and NFS, read-only, without extracting them.
longDescription:
sacdfs reads the SACD disc images (ISO files) in a folder and shows every track as a DSF or WAV file, decoded on the fly. Music players, Roon, Plex and file managers see ordinary files; the images stay unchanged and nothing is extracted to disk.

The share is named sacd: SMB on port 10445 and NFS on port 12049 (other ports than 445 and 2049, which the server's own file services may hold). It is read-only. Without an SMB user it is open to guests on your network.

The container mounts a FUSE file system, so it needs /dev/fuse and the capabilities SYS_ADMIN, DAC_OVERRIDE, DAC_READ_SEARCH, SETUID, SETGID, NET_BIND_SERVICE and SETPCAP; all others are dropped, no program can gain privileges, and it is not privileged. AppArmor is unconfined because Docker's default profile forbids mounting. Why each one: docs/deployment.md.
